title: Controls
description: The controls the wizard walks through, in capture order, with their drawing positions. Read by Core.swift (ControlSpec) and App.swift. File: data/controls.json.

id.description: Unique key, e.g. "a", "dpad.up", "ls.right". Captures and verify state refer to it.

prompt.description: What the wizard asks the user to press, e.g. "LB (left bumper)".

ident.description: Element identifier inside the personality plist, e.g. "button.lb" or "thumbstick.left.y". Empty for controls the personality cannot map.

kind.description: How a raw report counts as a press. button: HID button usage. axis: generic-desktop axis (sticks). hat: hat switch (D-pad). trigger: Simulation Accelerator/Brake, captured analog. system: not mappable (Xbox button, Share); shown in the drawing only.

gc.description: The element name Apple's GameController framework reports (localizedName), e.g. "A Button", "Left Thumbstick". Verify matches delivered events against it.

gcDir.description: For pads and sticks: the direction this control represents. Sets the highlighted edge and the arrow.

x.description: Centre of the hit target, as a fraction of the drawing width. Computed from the SVG's geometry, not measured by eye. Callouts can sit outside the art.

y.description: Centre as a fraction of the drawing height. Negative values place callouts above the art.

shape.description: Hit-target shape and size class. callout draws the silhouette from data/callout-glyphs.json keyed by id.

label.description: Text drawn on the target, e.g. "L3". Empty when the art already carries the glyph.

ax.description: For callouts: x of the leader line's anchor on the art, as a fraction of the drawing width.

ay.description: For callouts: y of the anchor on the art, as a fraction of the drawing height.
